MISSION: Help a student build a small, real set of evidence-based study habits.

spacedrep.name: Spaced Repetition
spacedrep.note: Reviewing material at increasing intervals rather than cramming once.

pomodoro.name: Pomodoro Technique
pomodoro.note: Timeboxed focus intervals with short breaks.

PRINCIPLES.en: Review material at increasing intervals rather than cramming once.
PRINCIPLES.en_short: Review at increasing intervals, not all at once.
PRINCIPLES.apply: Before your next exam, schedule three review passes spaced days apart instead of one long session.

PRINCIPLES.en: Test yourself on material instead of re-reading it passively.
PRINCIPLES.apply: Close the book and write down everything you remember before checking it again.

PRINCIPLES.en: Set aside fixed time each week to plan the next week's study blocks.
PRINCIPLES.en_short: Plan next week's study blocks on a fixed weekly slot.
PRINCIPLES.apply: Put a 20-minute weekly planning slot on your calendar and treat it as non-negotiable.

PRINCIPLES.en: Mix multiple subjects or problem types in one session rather than blocking by topic.
PRINCIPLES.en_short: Mix subjects/problem types instead of one block per topic.
PRINCIPLES.apply: In your next practice session, alternate between two subjects every 20 minutes instead of finishing one first.

PRINCIPLES.en: Work in fixed, timed intervals with short breaks between them.
PRINCIPLES.en_short: Work in timed intervals with short breaks.
PRINCIPLES.apply: Set a 25-minute timer for your next study block and take a 5-minute break when it ends, no exceptions.

PRINCIPLES.en: Remove predictable distractions from the study environment before starting.
PRINCIPLES.en_short: Remove predictable distractions before you start.
PRINCIPLES.apply: Before your next session, silence your phone and close every browser tab you don't need.

RELATIONS.evidence: Both are retrieval-strengthening techniques -- spaced repetition schedules the retrieval attempts active recall performs.
A weekly review typically schedules the interleaved sessions P04 describes.
Pomodoro blocks are commonly paired with environment control -- the timer alone doesn't help if the phone is still buzzing.
